normalization_or_editorial_flags.issue: Review روشنی کو بند constructions for more natural learner-facing Urdu such as روشنی بند کر دیں/دو or بتی بند کر دیں/دو.
Word order is stiff; prefer a natural equivalent such as آپ کتنی دیر ٹھہرے تھے؟
شرمندہ maps more directly to embarrassed/ashamed than to a straightforward apology; review semantic equivalence.
Prefer explicit interrogative form کیا یہ ایک حالیہ تصویر ہے؟ for a beginner workbook.
Normalize legacy/variant imperative/future spellings چڑھائو/کھائو to چڑھاؤ/کھاؤ.
ان کی / ان کے can be plural or honorific; English singular 'his' is ambiguous without context. Prefer unambiguous learner pairs.
Target is present/static ('requires some time') while English is future ('will take some time'); review tense alignment.
Passive الزام مجھے دیا جائے is unnatural for 'I'm the one to blame'; replace rather than duplicate rank 437.
Review mass/plural agreement for چاول ... اگتا/اگتے ہیں against target register.
یہ can be singular/plural; English 'these' is context-dependent. Prefer an unambiguous learner pair.
یہ پیو means 'Drink this'; English 'Take a sip of this' is more specific.
Normalize موقعہ to the preferred standard spelling موقع for this corpus.
English includes 'please' while Urdu relies on modal politeness; decide whether explicit براہِ مہربانی is required for equivalence consistency.
Target word order is highly awkward; rewrite idiomatically before learner release.
